kernel.note: Release 7.3.0-514.gravity: Fedora's kernel-7.3.3-200.fc44 packaging and configuration on the Linux 7.3 tarball, plus gravity-m4.patch (v7.3..ref): P3S and the Apple M4 platform support from the GravityLinux/linux integration branch (the bits/* topic branches merged in order). The J713 camera is disabled in its device tree.

mesa.note: Mesa 26.3.0-devel with Apple M4 GPU support (GL and Vulkan). CPU maps of shared dma-bufs wait for their implicit fences, which fixes torn frames in screen capture and remote desktop.

uboot-tools.note: Asahi/Fedora source plus nine checked-in Gravity patches through a2f6913694ff26908c16948af3f8372429782263; see UPSTREAM.md.

rust-speakersafetyd.note: Fedora f44 rust-speakersafetyd 2.0.1 (dist-git ce97ff700de0edbb672fc93c209688335bd4e065): crates.io source and Fedora's two patches, plus the J713 profile and udev rule (speakersafetyd branch j713-speakers 27ed8ede2a25, on upstream 2.0.1). Upstream speakersafetyd needs only that config for the J713; no fork is needed.

alsa-ucm-asahi.note: Fedora f44 alsa-ucm-asahi 10 (dist-git b11b0738875c4f2432549c7204eebc2cb7a17a4c): the upstream v10 tarball plus the J713 profile (alsa-ucm-conf-asahi branch j713 dd9e76c, on v10).

asahi-audio.note: Fedora f44 asahi-audio 4.1 (dist-git 19a447864c512320a55d82cb519c5bacbf2a49c1): the upstream v4.1 tarball plus the J713 alias of the J413 graph (asahi-audio branch j713 6de3ccc25f37, on v4.1).

gravity-bootloader.note: M4 bring-up on top of GravityLinux/bootloader main 79ff30c70f06: T8132 GPU calibration and core mask, MTP and AOP DAPF setup, system-level cache, CPU frequency init, ISP heap, NO_DISPLAY build, and m1n1.conf.example restored. Preserve DCP firmware-version and firmware-compat as 26.6.2; pair with the kernel's exact actual-version check.

gravity-scripts.note: Publish this locally pinned scripts commit to the Gravity repository.

gravity-installer.note: Qualified recovery extraction plus per-radio J773g Wi-Fi and Bluetooth factory calibration.

gravity-logos.note: CC-BY-4.0 artwork, MIT generator, separate trademark policy. Publish this locally pinned revision.
